messages:
zoe: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem. We hit a recurring pattern: secret rotation + validator deploys -> brief window of stale claims, and audit shipper missing ~15-45s of events during consumer rebalances. Need owners and a short remediation run.
matt: Curious if the pattern correlates with high deploy concurrency or GC spikes?
zoe: Both. Often during cross-service deploy waves and spikes in heap GC on the consumer host. Root cause notes are in the incident doc: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/incident/2282123456. Minimal repro: rotate secret -> validators restart -> gateway still uses cached claims until TTL or 401 triggers revalidate; if revalidate coincides with consumer rebalance, events can be lost.
oliver: I'll take cache invalidation work. Plan: add an event-driven invalidation hook from rotation service + immediate revalidate-on-401 fallback. Feature-flagged. ETA: 3 days.
sre-lead: I'll own the audit-shipper hardening: local bounded buffer + idempotent sink retries + consumer-lag alert tuning. Also add a temporary deploy throttle for rotation jobs. ETA: 36h.
zoe: Good. Action list for the ticket: 
- [ ] OLIVER: PR for event-driven invalidation + tests
- [ ] MATT: gateway revalidate-on-401 + integration test harness
- [ ] SRE-LEAD: audit-shipper buffer + retry + alert rules
- [ ] ZOE: update runbook with manual token-refresh steps and add a kill-switch for rotation jobs

matt: I'll add the integration test that simulates swap and validator order, and include traces showing the validation path. ETA: Mon.
oliver: PR opened: https://git.redwood.com/runtime/pulls/1602 - feature flag `auth.invalidate_on_rotation_v1`. Asking for reviews from @matt and @sre-lead.
sre-lead: Infra PR: https://git.redwood.com/infra/pulls/901 - local buffer + retry and consumer-lag alert at kafka.consumer.lag > 2500 -> page ops-sre. Also added a deploy throttle (1 rotation job per region).
sec-bot: Created SEC-3098: "token-validation-window" linked to SRV-4520. Watchers: zoe, matt, oliver, sre-lead. Status: in_progress.
zoe: Scheduling a 15m handoff tomorrow 08:30 PST to walk rollout and rollback criteria. Please bring PR links and smoke test steps.
matt: I'll bring the integration test results and kill-switch script for revalidate flag.
oliver: I'll bring rollout notes and the feature-flag toggles.
sre-lead: I'll bring consumer lag dashboards and the throttle config.
zoe: Final: treat this as a 5-day remediation sprint with daily 10m syncs. If an owner needs extension, mark it in SEC-3098. :thumbsup:
matt: ack
oliver: ack
sre-lead: ack
sec-bot: SEC-3098 status updated: owners assigned.
